DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Six Masks, One Empty Slot

STS-HS10-L2-6501000-HSVPA910-PZQ-GBL-01 • HS Theatre Grades 9–10 • Cultural and Historical Belief Systems in Theatre
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Every mask on that wall was built by people answering a question about what they believed. A Noh mask was carved to let a spirit speak. A Commedia mask was shaped so a whole town could recognize a character from the back row. A West African dance mask was made to carry an ancestor into a ceremony, not into a show.
If your class made a mask that told the world what your community believes, what would you carve into it?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
